//package CodeForces;

import java.util.Scanner;

public class SequenceWithDigits {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner s=new Scanner(System.in);
		int t=s.nextInt();
		while(t>0)
		{
			long n=s.nextLong();
			long k=s.nextLong();
			
			long num=n;
			while(k-1>0)
			{
				//System.out.println(k);
				long temp=num;
				long x=num%10;
				long min=x;long max=x;
				while(num>0)
				{
					x=num%10;
					min=Math.min(min,x);
					max=Math.max(max,x);
					num=num/10;
				}
				num=temp+min*max;
				//System.out.println(num);
				if(min==0)
				{
					break;
				}
				k--;
			}
			
			System.out.println(num);
			t--;
		}

	}

}
